plain_english: Any changes to this agreement must be put in writing and signed by both you and the client.
what_it_means_for_you: You can’t rely on verbal promises; any change has to be documented and signed by both parties.
risk_reasons: The clause only requires written, signed amendments, which is a standard protection for both sides.
It prevents either party from altering the contract unilaterally.
questions_to_ask: What process will we use to draft and sign amendments?
evidence_quote: Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.
